title: Count Employees by Department
description_markdown: Count the number of employees in each department. Return `dept_id` and `COUNT(*) AS employee_count`, grouped by `dept_id`. Exclude employees with NULL `dept_id`. Order by `dept_id` ascending.
starter_query:
-- Group by dept_id
SELECT dept_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count
FROM employees
WHERE dept_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ...
solution_query: SELECT dept_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees WHERE dept_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dept_id ORDER BY dept_id ASC;
solution_explanation: GROUP BY partitions matching rows by `dept_id` and applies the COUNT(*) aggregate function to each partition.
hints: Filter out NULLs with `WHERE dept_id IS NOT NULL`.
Add `GROUP BY dept_id ORDER BY dept_id ASC`.
Query: SELECT dept_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees WHERE dept_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dept_id ORDER BY dept_id ASC;

title: Departmental Average Salary Benchmark
